cousins.text: A hundred brothers. Five cousins. One throne.

needle.text: Duryodhana will not give a needle-point of earth.

bhishma.text: Bhishma, the grandsire, leads the Kauravas.

drona.text: Drona taught them all. Now he fights for Duryodhana.

karna.text: Karna, born in armour, will not fight while Bhishma lives.
Karna will not fight while Bhishma lives.

arjuna.text: Arjuna, the archer, chose Krishna over an army.

krishna.text: Krishna will lift no weapon. He drives the chariot.

bhima.text: Bhima has sworn to break Duryodhana's thigh.

conch.text: The conches sound. The first arrows fly.

between.text: Arjuna asks for his chariot between the armies.

lowers.text: He sees teachers and kin. He lowers his bow.

time.text: Krishna shows his supreme form. I am Time.

promise.text: Taken from the Critical Edition, the text scholars read.
Taken from the Critical Edition, the text scholars read. Nothing added for effect.
